source.publication: 2025 Form MO-1040, Form MO-A and Form MO-1040 Instructions (Missouri Department of Revenue); 2025 Missouri Income Tax Reference Guide (Form 4711)
source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section C; instructions PDF p17 Section C Lines 1-2 and Worksheet for Lines 1 and 2; Reference Guide PDF p9; record social_security_retirement_subtraction; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section A Lines 1-5; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9 (47,633 per taxpayer); record public_pension_subtraction

worked: Single, age 60. Under 62, so no Social Security exemption: Line 3 is 0, the pension exemption is not reduced, and the benefits stay taxed. Federal taxable Social Security: other income 50,000.00 + half of benefits 10,000.00 = provisional 60,000.00; 85% x (60,000.00 - 34,000.00) + 4,500.00 = 26,600.00, limited to 85% x 20,000.00 = 17,000.00. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 20,000.00 + pensions 30,000.00 + taxable Social Security 17,000.00 = 67,000.00. Federal taxable income = 67,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 51,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 67,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 67,000.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 67,000.00 - 0.00 = 67,000.00. MO-A Part 3 Section C (Y, age 60): Line 1 17,000.00; Line 3 0.00 (under 62 at December 31, no exemption; the benefit stays taxed). Section C Line 4 total 0.00. Section A (Y): Line 1 30,000.00; Line 2 lesser of that or 47,633.00 = 30,000.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 30,000.00. Section A Line 5 total 30,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 30,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 67,000.00 - 30,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 21,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 21,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 1,313.00 = 39.39 + 3.5% x 1,313.00 = 45.955 + 4% x 1,313.00 = 52.52 + 4.5% x 1,313.00 = 59.085 + 4.7% x 12,059.00 = 566.773; total 822.808 = 822.81. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 823; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 67,000.00 - Line 8 30,000.00 = 37,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 67,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
